question: What point-in-time observable best represents Taiwan ETF fund-size creation/redemption pressure without confusing market-price/NAV moves with primary-market flow?
officialEvidence: TWSE issuer integration specification requires current outstanding beneficial units and the difference from the prior day, with data date and data time.
TWSE states ETF issuers publish a daily PCF for in-kind creation/redemption, defining the basket for one creation/redemption unit or an integer multiple.
TWSE distinguishes in-kind versus cash creation/redemption; cash products do not support the same stock-basket inference.
TWSE split/reverse-split announcements show PCF unit counts can mechanically reflect corporate actions, so unit changes need a corporate-action guard.

primaryFlowObject.name: netUnitsDelta
primaryFlowObject.sourceField: today outstanding units - previous-day outstanding units
primaryFlowObject.interpretation: Net ETF fund-size change in beneficial units, after corporate-action validation.
primaryFlowObject.whyPreferredToAumDelta: AUM changes with both units and NAV/market value. Units delta more directly isolates net primary-market fund-size change.

accountingGuard.implication: Delta AUM contains a units-flow term plus a NAV-change term (and interaction), so Delta AUM alone cannot identify primary-market creations/redemptions.

pcfContext.inKind: For in-kind ETFs, daily PCF identifies the basket required per creation/redemption base unit. A modeled basket-exposure proxy may be constructed only with PIT-consistent units delta, creation-unit size, PCF composition and cash-substitution semantics.
pcfContext.cash: For cash creation/redemption ETFs, units delta can measure net fund-size change but does not map mechanically to same-day constituent stock quantities.
pcfContext.reason: Authorized participants may use inventory, hedges, secondary-market trades and timing choices; net ETF units do not reveal exact execution.

criticalFalsification: Net units delta of zero does not prove zero gross primary-market activity; same-day creations and redemptions may offset.
Positive units delta is not automatically bullish for every constituent and does not prove same-day market buying.
Negative units delta is not automatically bearish and does not prove same-day market selling.
ETF split/reverse-split or other unit-changing corporate actions can create a large units delta without economic inflow/outflow.
PCF may contain cash-substitution rules; basket quantities must not be treated as delivered stock when cash substitution is permitted.
The issuer/TWSE current interface proves prospective capture feasibility, not a complete historical first-known archive.
eventSeparation: scheduled benchmark/index rebalance changes target weights
ETF net creation/redemption changes fund size
both can overlap but must remain separate causal channels
multiple ETFs tracking the same benchmark contribute tracker exposure, not independent benchmark events

exactNext: Audit issuer/TWSE prospective source stability on a bounded set of domestic in-kind Taiwan-equity ETFs and verify timestamp/PCF alignment. Preserve split/corporate-action and cash-substitution states. Do not backfill historical first-known units/PCF from current pages and do not start outcome tests before clean prospective receipts exist.
